method: Verification checkpoint over already-mature, already-tested logic (analysis/ict_displacement.py, analysis/ict_structure_shift.py) -- no production code changed for this checkpoint.

required_evidence_present.structural_level_affected: implicit via the sweep/MSS chain it is gated behind
required_evidence_present.setup_ownership: via displacement_id, chained into the eventual setup_id

displacement.not_every_large_candle_is_displacement: PASS -- gated on body_atr_threshold/range_atr_threshold/close_location_threshold/impulse_score_threshold, all configurable, tested in tests/test_ict_2022_v2.py::test_displacement_is_atr_normalized_and_after_sweep
displacement.requires_completed_post_sweep_candle: PASS -- only scans candles after the sweep's reclaim_time

choch_mss.requires_pre_existing_structural_referen: PASS -- pivots are searched only in `before=rows.loc[times<sweep_time]`, i.e. strictly before the sweep; pivot_known_at_sweep=True is true by construction, never asserted for a pivot discovered after the fact
choch_mss.requires_completed_close_through_referen: PASS -- breaks filter checks `.close` against the pivot level, not high/low (wick-only crossings do not qualify); close_confirmed=False until a completed candle satisfies this
choch_mss.correct_direction: PASS -- buy direction requires a high pivot broken upward, sell requires a low pivot broken downward, enforced structurally not just labeled
choch_mss.correct_structural_episode: PASS -- pivot search is scoped to the same candle frame passed in for this specific sweep/displacement pair, never mixed across unrelated episodes
choch_mss.no_future_swing_ownership: PASS -- verified above, this is the core causality guarantee of the function
choch_mss.no_duplicate_confirmation: PASS -- `pivots[-1]` selects exactly one (the most recent pre-sweep) pivot candidate per call; the caller (strategies/ict_2022_v2.py) invokes this once per direction per decision
choch_mss.wick_only_false_breaks_fail: PASS -- confirmed by construction (close-only breaks filter) and by existing test coverage (test_ict_2022_v2.py's wick-only-sweep-is-forming-not-confirmed covers the analogous sweep case; MSS inherits the same completed-close discipline)
choch_mss.incomplete_candles_cannot_confirm_struct: PASS -- MSS only operates on rows already filtered to completed candles by the shared upstream completed_candles() boundary (analysis/top_down_engine.py), and additionally requires `close_confirmed` from an actual close price, not a forming candle's provisional close

when_confirmation_missing.lifecycle_remains_waiting: PASS -- evidence_result's state defaults to 'forming' (if a forming_candle is provided) or 'waiting', never fabricates 'pass'
when_confirmation_missing.no_entry_emitted: PASS -- strategies/ict_2022_v2.py's core-sequence chain (sweep -> displacement -> MSS -> FVG) requires every prior stage valid before the next runs; entry_available requires the full chain
when_confirmation_missing.no_actionable_overlays: PASS -- consistent with the Phase 2/3-established rule that actionable overlays only exist when trade_ready, which requires the complete chain

verified_via: Direct source reading of both functions (no test gaps found requiring new coverage)
